formula_observations: Aqueous, alcohol-free pump spray (no Alcohol Denat., no propellant). FIXATIVES: Acrylates Copolymer #2 and Polyurethane-34 #3 (both right after Aqua; high-level film-formers); Acrylates/Beheneth-25 Methacrylate Copolymer #6 (associative thickener/rheology, counted as polymer but not a primary fixative); Aminomethyl Propanol #10 = neutraliser for the acrylates. CONDITIONING: none (no cationic, no fatty alcohol; Polysorbate 80 #9 and Methylpropanediol #15 are non-conditioning). First preservative: Phenoxyethanol #4. Perfume (Parfum) #7. SALTS: none of sodium chloride/magnesium sulfate/sea salt; mineral particle Calcium Carbonate #11 (texturising powder, not a salt-spray salt); Sodium Lauryl Sulfate #14 (surfactant). SILICONES: PEG-12 Dimethicone #8 (water-soluble silicone). OILS/WAXES/STARCHES: none. Tocopherol last (#24).
claim_tier_detail: German claims from easycosmetic.de (C3 retailer for third-party brand); English product photo on lookfantastic.at corroborates 'sea salt-free'/medium hold. No redken.de page found. German pack not seen.
notes: Only salt-free beach-wave spray found sold in Germany; no drugstore (dm/Rossmann/Müller) product with beach-wave promise and no salt was found: dm's beach sprays (Balea Sea Salt Texture Spray, Balea Leave-In Sea Salt Care & Define, Jean&Len Sea Salt Spray, Bali Gents Sea Salt Spray, alverde Beach Waves Maris Sal) all carry salt. Availability weak: both German/Austrian retailers showed out-of-stock at capture; price on lookfantastic.at EUR 29.33 (sold out). UK Redken page reportedly mixes 'sea-salt free' and 'salt-infused' wording - INCI shows no sodium chloride/magnesium sulfate. Hold stated by retailer only.
